---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature for InfraLayer
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'needs-triage']
assignees: ''
---

## 🚀 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Motivation / Use Case

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve? Who would benefit?

## 📋 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Include API sketches, configuration options, or behavior details.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is this the best option?

## 📦 Package(s) Affected

- [ ] @infralayer/core (TypeScript core)
- [ ] @infralayer/sdk (TypeScript SDK)
- [ ] infralayer (Python SDK)
- [ ] Documentation / Examples
- [ ] Benchmarks / Tests

## 🧪 Testing Considerations

How should this feature be tested? Any specific test cases or edge cases?

## 📚 Documentation Impact

What documentation would need to be updated?

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues for duplicates
- [ ] This feature aligns with InfraLayer's security-first philosophy
- [ ] I'm willing to help implement this feature (optional)
